# GDP at market prices and at factor cost — multiple choice

Pick the one right answer.

**1. (Sub lesson 1)** GDP at market prices values output at —
a) what factors receive
b) what buyers actually pay
c) production cost only
**Answer: b) what buyers actually pay**

**2. (Sub lesson 2)** GDP at factor cost is found from market prices by —
a) adding indirect taxes, removing subsidies
b) removing indirect taxes, adding subsidies
c) ignoring both
**Answer: b) removing indirect taxes, adding subsidies**

**3. (Sub lesson 3)** To see incomes generated by production, use GDP at —
a) market prices
b) factor cost
c) retail prices
**Answer: b) factor cost**
